android.recovery.title: Your squad is still out there
android.recovery.detail: An interrupted battle is saved on this device. Resume from the last saved moment, or retreat and collect the rewards you earned.
android.recovery.error: This battle could not be recovered. Your saved progress and battle record have been preserved. Please contact support.
android.blueprints.empty: No blueprints match. Try another search or filter.
android.blueprints.detail: Tap a card to explore its blueprint
android.shop.note: Cosmetics are optional. Prices come from the Amazon Appstore. Restore purchases using the Amazon account that bought them. All gameplay and progression remain available without buying a pack.
android.shop.restore.empty: No previous cosmetic purchases were found for this Amazon account.
android.shop.connect: Amazon checkout is not connected yet. Check your internet connection, sign in to the Amazon Appstore and use the Amazon-installed version, then retry. You have not been charged.
android.shop.loading: Connecting to Amazon. Prices will appear when the store responds. You can retry if the connection takes too long.
android.shop.product: Amazon has not returned a price for this pack in your marketplace. Retry the store or choose another pack. You have not been charged.
android.shop.overlap: You already own content included in this pack. Choose an individual cosmetic to avoid buying the same content twice.
android.shop.timeout: Amazon did not respond in time. Check your internet connection and Amazon Appstore sign-in, then retry. No new purchase has been started.
android.shop.failed: Amazon did not complete this purchase. Try again, or use Restore purchases if you already bought this pack.
